examples.text: Seine unsystematische Suche brachte ihn keinen Schritt weiter.

glosses: Not systematic; random, disorganised, or unthorough.

examples.text: None of the traditional proposals suffers from the weaknesses characteristic of CAW's suggestions: what CAW has to offer are mere guesses, arrived at in a totally unsystematic way and totally unsupported by rational and reasonable argumentation.

glosses: adj. adv. 非系统性的，可避免的
